title: Multistability and predominant hybrid phenotypes in a four node mutually repressive network of Th1/Th2/Th17/Treg differentiation.
authors: Duddu, Atchuta Srinivas; Andreas, Elizabeth; Bv, Harshavardhan; Grover, Kaushal; Singh, Vivek Raj; Hari, Kishore; Jhunjhunwala, Siddharth; Cummins, Breschine; Gedeon, Tomas; Jolly, Mohit Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文用布尔网络模型研究Th1/Th2/Th17/Treg分化中四节点互抑网络的多稳态与混合表型，虽涉及转录因子调控网络，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或三维结构建模，且方法为抽象动力学模拟而非AI或物理分子模拟，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Elucidating the emergent dynamics of cellular differentiation networks is crucial to understanding cell-fate decisions. Toggle switch - a network of mutually repressive lineage-specific transcription factors A and B - enables two phenotypes from a common progenitor: (high A, low B) and (low A, high B). However, the dynamics of networks enabling differentiation of more than two phenotypes from a progenitor cell has not been well-studied. Here, we investigate the dynamics of a four-node network A, B, C, and D inhibiting each other, forming a toggle tetrahedron. Our simulations show that this network is multistable and predominantly allows for the co-existence of six hybrid phenotypes where two of the nodes are expressed relatively high as compared to the remaining two, for instance (high A, high B, low C, low D). Finally, we apply our results to understand naive CD4(+) T cell differentiation into Th1, Th2, Th17 and Treg subsets, suggesting Th1/Th2/Th17/Treg decision-making to be a two-step process.
abstract_zh: 阐明细胞分化网络的涌现动态对于理解细胞命运决定至关重要。切换开关——一个由相互抑制的谱系特异性转录因子A和B组成的网络——能够从共同祖细胞产生两种表型：（高A，低B）和（低A，高B）。然而，能够从祖细胞分化出多于两种表型的网络动态尚未得到充分研究。在此，我们研究了由A、B、C和D四个节点相互抑制形成的切换四面体网络的动态。我们的模拟表明，该网络是多稳态的，并且主要允许六种混合表型共存，其中两个节点相对于其余两个节点表达较高，例如（高A，高B，低C，低D）。最后，我们将我们的结果应用于理解初始CD4(+) T细胞分化为Th1、Th2、Th17和Treg亚群，提示Th1/Th2/Th17/Treg决策是一个两步过程。
